Card Q&A.a: No battle occurs, and the attack ends. If there are other When Attacking effects, "when one of your Digimon attacks" effects, and/or effects activated at counter timing, they activate, and then the attack ends. If it's then blocked at blocker timing, start a battle with the blocking Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: I use this Digimon to attack an opponent's Digimon, then use this Digimon's inherited effect to reduce the opponent's Digimon to 0 DP and delete it. What happens to the attack?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have 3 or more yellow Tamers in play, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
